name: tmux-agents
description: herdr-style Agents sidebar, tab icons and notifications for tmux (Claude Code + OpenCode)

scripts.check: sh -n bin/tmux-agents && sh -n tmux-agents.tmux && sh -n install.sh && sh -n tests/install.sh && bun build sidebar/sidebar.ts opencode/tui.js --target bun --outdir /tmp/tmux-agents-check >/dev/null && echo ok
